card_title: Artist Notes: Extrait de Parfum: Obsidian Core
summary: Absolute olfactory density. A highly concentrated, viscous perfume extract that delivers a dark, impenetrable aura of smoke and leather.
description: The deepest expression of scent. Boasting a staggering 30% concentration of essential oils, this extrait sits intimately on the skin, unfolding a slow, linear narrative of burnt birch, raw leather, and black pepper.
technical_overview: Offered at $160.0 for 30ml, this KoColor PERFUME is expertly formulated with High-Concentrate Essential Oils, Birch Tar, and Iso E Super. It delivers a high-fidelity Deep Amber color profile (`#FF8C00`) and leverages high-density volatile slow-release.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Dab a single micro-drop onto the jugular and the inner wrists. Do not rub.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Extrait de Parfum requires the natural heat of the body to activate; apply exclusively to bare skin, never to clothing.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Iso E Super acts as a massive olfactory amplifier, increasing the wearer's natural pheromonal projection.
